title: Goal-Affordance Traps v1
description: Sixty everyday goal/precondition scenarios, each rendered as hostile, explicit, neutral, and goal-counterfactual binary-choice conditions.

source.title: Goal-Affordance Traps v1
source.generation_note: Human seeds plus GPT/Claude/Gemini proposals; every selected scenario was human-curated and normalized before evaluation.

scenario_source.goal: I want to have my car washed at the car wash nearby.
scenario_source.neutral_context: The car is parked beside me and the car wash is 50 meters away.
scenario_source.salient_cue: For such a short distance, walking there would normally be quicker than starting the car, pulling out, and parking again.
scenario_source.precondition: The car itself must arrive at the car wash for it to be washed.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: I only want to ask the car wash about prices; I am not having the car washed now.
scenario_source.correct_action: drive there
scenario_source.rationale: The object being acted on—the car—must be transported to the service.

scenario_source.goal: I want the nearby courier counter to accept my parcel return.
scenario_source.neutral_context: The sealed parcel is beside me and the counter is downstairs.
scenario_source.salient_cue: The parcel is bulky, and going downstairs empty-handed would be faster and easier.
scenario_source.precondition: The counter cannot accept the return unless the parcel is brought there.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: I only want to ask the counter whether this type of purchase is returnable.
scenario_source.correct_action: take the parcel with me to the counter
scenario_source.rationale: The return target must be present for the return to be accepted.

scenario_source.goal: I want to show my laptop slides on the meeting-room projector.
scenario_source.neutral_context: The meeting room is across the hall, and the required display adapter is on my desk.
scenario_source.salient_cue: The meeting is starting now, so walking straight into the room is the quickest move.
scenario_source.precondition: The laptop cannot connect to that projector without the display adapter.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: I only want to tell the attendees that the presentation will start later.
scenario_source.correct_action: pick up the adapter before entering the meeting room
scenario_source.lure_action: go straight into the meeting room
scenario_source.rationale: A required tool must accompany the agent to complete the display goal.

scenario_source.goal: I want to inflate the bicycle tire in the courtyard.
scenario_source.neutral_context: The bicycle is in the courtyard and the only pump is in my apartment.
scenario_source.salient_cue: The courtyard is very close, and carrying the long pump down the stairs is awkward.
scenario_source.precondition: There is no other pump or inflation device in the courtyard.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: I only want to inspect the tire to see whether it looks flat.
scenario_source.correct_action: bring the pump down to the courtyard
scenario_source.rationale: The inflation tool is unavailable at the destination unless it is transported.

scenario_source.goal: I want to collect my prescription from the pharmacy.
scenario_source.neutral_context: The pharmacy is nearby, but my required photo ID is upstairs.
scenario_source.salient_cue: Going directly to the pharmacy avoids backtracking and gets me to the counter sooner.
scenario_source.precondition: The pharmacy requires the photo ID before releasing this prescription.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: I only want to ask the pharmacy when the prescription will be ready.
scenario_source.correct_action: go upstairs for the photo ID first
scenario_source.rationale: The transaction requires a resource that must be obtained before arrival.

scenario_source.goal: I want to board my train using my paper ticket.
scenario_source.neutral_context: The station entrance is close, but the paper ticket is on my desk.
scenario_source.salient_cue: Walking straight to the station is the shortest route and the train leaves soon.
scenario_source.precondition: There is no digital copy or replacement ticket available at the station.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: I only want to check the departure board outside the station.
scenario_source.correct_action: go back for the paper ticket first
scenario_source.rationale: Boarding requires the ticket even though retrieving it adds travel time.

scenario_source.goal: We want the bank to close an account that belongs to Mina.
scenario_source.neutral_context: Mina is ten minutes away; her friend is already beside the bank.
scenario_source.salient_cue: The friend could reach the counter immediately, while waiting for Mina takes longer.
scenario_source.precondition: The bank requires the account owner to authorize the closure in person.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: We only want someone to pick up a leaflet about account closure.
scenario_source.correct_action: wait for Mina and have her go to the bank
scenario_source.lure_action: send the nearby friend to the bank now
scenario_source.rationale: The selected agent must possess the authority required by the goal.

scenario_source.goal: We want the recurring electrical fault professionally repaired.
scenario_source.neutral_context: A licensed electrician is farther away; an untrained coworker is nearby.
scenario_source.salient_cue: The coworker could look at it immediately and calling the electrician causes a delay.
scenario_source.precondition: The repair requires a licensed electrician and is not a visual inspection.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: We only want someone to note which indicator light is blinking.
scenario_source.correct_action: wait for the licensed electrician
scenario_source.lure_action: have the nearby coworker handle it now
scenario_source.rationale: Availability is not a substitute for the capability required by the repair.

scenario_source.goal: I want to bake the cake according to a recipe that assumes a preheated oven.
scenario_source.neutral_context: The filled cake pan is ready and the oven is currently cold.
scenario_source.salient_cue: Putting the pan in immediately starts sooner and avoids waiting for preheating.
scenario_source.precondition: The recipe's baking time and result require the oven to reach temperature first.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: For an experiment, I want to observe what happens when this cake starts in a cold oven.
scenario_source.correct_action: wait for the oven to preheat before putting the cake in
scenario_source.rationale: The required initial state must be reached before the main action begins.

scenario_source.goal: I want the device firmware update to complete without losing power.
scenario_source.neutral_context: The device battery is at 5 percent and the charger is available.
scenario_source.salient_cue: Opening the update screen now feels faster than waiting for the battery to charge.
scenario_source.precondition: The device cannot be charged during this update and power loss can corrupt it.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: Open the update screen now only to verify that it loads; do not begin the installation.
scenario_source.correct_action: charge the device before starting the update
scenario_source.rationale: Sufficient battery state is a prerequisite for completing the update safely.

scenario_source.goal: I want this trip upstairs to provide some physical exercise.
scenario_source.neutral_context: Both the stairs and the elevator reach the same floor.
scenario_source.salient_cue: The elevator is faster and requires less effort than climbing the stairs.
scenario_source.precondition: The chosen trip itself must involve physical exertion to satisfy the goal.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: I want to reach the upstairs floor as quickly and easily as possible.
scenario_source.correct_action: use the stairs
scenario_source.rationale: The locally efficient means conflicts with the stated exercise objective.

scenario_source.goal: I want to avoid using a new single-use plastic bottle for my water.
scenario_source.neutral_context: A refill station is farther down the hall; bottled water is sold beside me.
scenario_source.salient_cue: Buying the nearby bottled water is quicker than walking to the refill station.
scenario_source.precondition: Buying that water would require taking a new single-use plastic bottle.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: I want to get drinking water with the least possible walking.
scenario_source.correct_action: walk to the refill station
scenario_source.rationale: The shortest action directly violates the stated waste-reduction objective.

scenario_source.goal: I want the new adhesive hook to hold a weighted test pouch for a full hour.
scenario_source.neutral_context: The hook was attached one minute ago, and its adhesive needs twenty-four hours to cure before carrying weight.
scenario_source.salient_cue: The pouch is ready, so hanging it now would start the one-hour test immediately.
scenario_source.precondition: The adhesive must finish curing before the load test begins.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: Observe immediately how the uncured hook responds when the test pouch is added.
scenario_source.correct_action: Wait for the adhesive to cure before hanging the pouch.
scenario_source.lure_action: Hang the test pouch on the hook now.
scenario_source.rationale: Starting the timed test early prevents the hook from satisfying its load goal.

scenario_source.goal: I want to mix this frozen reference solution evenly before measuring it.
scenario_source.neutral_context: The sealed vial is still mostly frozen, and the protocol requires it to thaw completely before mixing.
scenario_source.salient_cue: Shaking it now would begin the mixing step instead of waiting for the ice to melt.
scenario_source.precondition: The solution must be fully liquid before it can be mixed evenly.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: Shake the sealed vial once right now only to check whether the ice moves, not to mix the solution.
scenario_source.correct_action: Wait for the vial to thaw completely, then mix it.
scenario_source.rationale: A mostly frozen vial cannot be mixed into an even solution.

scenario_source.goal: Make sure the borrowed cello is on stage for the 7 pm recital.
scenario_source.neutral_context: Mira is at home; the borrowed cello is leaning against the wall in her hallway, and the recital hall is a fifteen-minute walk away.
scenario_source.salient_cue: A friend texts that the stage door closes to people at 6:55 and the queue outside is already forming.
scenario_source.precondition: The cello cannot get to the hall unless someone carries it there.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: Make sure Mira is seated in the hall before the stage door closes.
scenario_source.correct_action: Pick up the cello and carry it to the hall.
scenario_source.lure_action: Head straight to the hall to get through the stage door.
scenario_source.rationale: The goal is about the instrument's location, but the cue reframes the deadline as being about the person's own entry, making a solo dash feel urgent even though it leaves the cello at home.

scenario_source.goal: Get the foster kitten to its 4 pm checkup.
scenario_source.neutral_context: Dev is at the shelter office; the kitten is in a carrier in the back room, and the vet clinic is two blocks away.
scenario_source.salient_cue: The clinic just called to say the vet is running early and will take the next arrival immediately.
scenario_source.precondition: The kitten only reaches the clinic if it is brought there.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: Go to the clinic alone now to claim the early slot before bringing the kitten.
scenario_source.correct_action: Collect the carrier, then walk to the clinic.
scenario_source.lure_action: Walk to the clinic alone now to take the open slot.
scenario_source.rationale: The 'next arrival' framing rewards personal speed, but arriving without the patient cannot accomplish a checkup of the kitten.

scenario_source.goal: Deliver half the sourdough starter to Ana's kitchen this morning.
scenario_source.neutral_context: Tom's starter jar is cooling in his basement fridge, and Ana lives one street over.
scenario_source.salient_cue: Ana writes that she is leaving for work in ten minutes and her front door is unlocked right now.
scenario_source.precondition: The starter will only be in Ana's kitchen if Tom brings the jar with him.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: Catch Ana in person before she leaves for work.
scenario_source.correct_action: Fetch the jar from the basement, then go over.
scenario_source.lure_action: Go straight over while the door is still open.
scenario_source.rationale: The narrow open-door window makes immediate departure feel optimal, but the deliverable is the starter, not Tom's presence.

scenario_source.goal: Tighten the loose bolts on the field bleachers before the game.
scenario_source.neutral_context: Priya is in the equipment shed; the bleachers are across the field and the torque wrench lives in the maintenance van parked by the gate.
scenario_source.salient_cue: The groundskeeper radios that he is standing at the bleachers now and can point out every loose bolt if she comes straight over.
scenario_source.precondition: The bolts can only be tightened with the torque wrench.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: Get a walkthrough of which bleacher bolts are loose before the groundskeeper leaves.
scenario_source.correct_action: Stop at the van for the wrench, then cross the field.
scenario_source.lure_action: Head straight across the field to the bleachers.
scenario_source.rationale: The cue offers a genuinely valuable but non-goal benefit for going directly, which competes with the detour that the actual repair requires.

scenario_source.goal: Inspect the far hive's brood frames this afternoon.
scenario_source.neutral_context: Owen is at the farmhouse; the smoker he uses to calm the bees is hanging in the barn, and the far hive is at the edge of the orchard.
scenario_source.salient_cue: Clouds are building, and the orchard path is shortest if he cuts straight out the back gate now.
scenario_source.precondition: Owen only opens a hive after smoking it, and the smoker is the only one on the property.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: Reach the far hive before the rain starts to check whether its roof is still weighted down.
scenario_source.correct_action: Grab the smoker from the barn, then walk out.
scenario_source.lure_action: Take the back gate straight to the far hive.
scenario_source.rationale: Weather pressure makes the direct route feel obligatory, but the inspection itself is gated on a tool stored the other way.

scenario_source.goal: Aliquot the thawed samples in the cold room before they warm up.
scenario_source.neutral_context: Lena is at her bench; the calibrated pipette assigned to that protocol sits in the shared instrument alcove down the corridor.
scenario_source.salient_cue: A colleague messages that the cold room is empty for the next few minutes, which never happens at this hour.
scenario_source.precondition: The aliquots must be measured with the calibrated pipette.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: Get into the cold room while it is empty to log the freezer temperatures.
scenario_source.correct_action: Collect the calibrated pipette, then go to the cold room.
scenario_source.lure_action: Go to the cold room while it is still empty.
scenario_source.rationale: Scarcity of access makes immediate entry feel like the dominant move, though the measuring step cannot begin without the instrument.

scenario_source.goal: Start the studio's overnight kiln firing tonight.
scenario_source.neutral_context: Sam is locking up the front of the ceramics studio; the kiln is in the back room and the firing schedule card for this glaze is clipped inside the office binder.
scenario_source.salient_cue: The studio manager left a note saying the back room lights shut off automatically at nine, and it is ten to nine.
scenario_source.precondition: The kiln's ramp settings must be entered from the schedule card for that glaze.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: Check that the kiln shelves are loaded correctly before the lights cut out.
scenario_source.correct_action: Pull the schedule card from the binder, then go back.
scenario_source.lure_action: Go to the back room before the lights shut off.
scenario_source.rationale: A hard lighting deadline pushes toward arrival, but programming the firing depends on information held elsewhere.

scenario_source.goal: Seal the newly grouted bathroom tile today.
scenario_source.neutral_context: Hal has the bathroom taped off and his tools laid out; the sealant he bought is still in the trunk of the car in the garage.
scenario_source.salient_cue: His partner says the bathroom is free for exactly one hour starting now, and after that the kids need it.
scenario_source.precondition: Sealing the grout consumes the bottle of sealant.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: Use the free hour to wipe the grout haze off the tile face.
scenario_source.correct_action: Get the sealant from the trunk, then start.
scenario_source.lure_action: Start working in the bathroom while it is free.
scenario_source.rationale: The one-hour window makes immediate work feel efficient, yet the task's defining consumable is not in the room.

scenario_source.goal: Get the lease amendment notarized this afternoon.
scenario_source.neutral_context: Rosa is at her desk; the notary keeps walk-in hours until four in the building lobby, and the printed amendment is in the file drawer of the office she shares upstairs.
scenario_source.salient_cue: A coworker mentions the notary's queue is empty right now but usually stretches thirty minutes by three.
scenario_source.precondition: The notary can only notarize the printed amendment that Rosa signs in front of her.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: Ask the notary about her availability for tomorrow's closing while there is no queue.
scenario_source.correct_action: Retrieve the printed amendment, then go down to the lobby.
scenario_source.lure_action: Go down to the lobby while the queue is empty.
scenario_source.rationale: Queue avoidance is a real and vivid gain, but notarization has nothing to act on without the document.

scenario_source.goal: Get the community pool open for swimming again after the chemical check.
scenario_source.neutral_context: The check is finished and the water is cleared; the desk attendant is standing at the gate, and the on-duty lifeguard is in the staff room at the other end of the building.
scenario_source.salient_cue: Swimmers are pressed against the gate and the attendant already has the gate key in her hand.
scenario_source.precondition: Swimming is permitted only while a lifeguard is stationed at the poolside chair.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: Get the pool gate unlocked so swimmers can reach the changing rooms.
scenario_source.correct_action: Fetch the lifeguard to take the poolside chair.
scenario_source.lure_action: Have the attendant unlock the gate now.
scenario_source.rationale: The nearer staff member can complete a visible sub-step, which reads as the goal until one notes what makes swimming permissible.

scenario_source.goal: Have the witness's statement recorded as sworn testimony this morning.
scenario_source.neutral_context: The witness speaks only Portuguese; a bilingual paralegal is sitting in the same conference room, and the court-appointed interpreter is finishing another matter down the hall.
scenario_source.salient_cue: The court reporter says she can only stay another twenty minutes, and the paralegal offers to start translating immediately.
scenario_source.precondition: Testimony is recorded as sworn only when rendered by the court-appointed interpreter.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: Let the bilingual paralegal translate the witness's next answer now as an informal preview, not as sworn testimony.
scenario_source.correct_action: Bring in the court-appointed interpreter.
scenario_source.lure_action: Let the paralegal translate for the reporter now.
scenario_source.rationale: A willing, competent, closer helper plus a shrinking window makes the shortcut feel responsible, though it cannot produce the specific status the goal names.

scenario_source.goal: Refill the aquarium so the fish have their full water level tonight.
scenario_source.neutral_context: Jonah has a bucket of tap water standing beside the tank and the fish are in the tank; the dechlorinator bottle sits on the shelf above.
scenario_source.salient_cue: The water in the bucket is already at room temperature, and the tank pump is starting to whine at the low level.
scenario_source.precondition: Tap water must be treated with dechlorinator before it goes in with the fish.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: Stop the pump running for now without adding any water to the aquarium.
scenario_source.correct_action: Treat the bucket with dechlorinator, then pour it in.
scenario_source.rationale: Temperature match and a whining pump make pouring feel both prepared and urgent, but the stated goal concerns the fish's water, which requires the treatment step.

scenario_source.goal: Record a clean voiceover take with no background noise in the next hour.
scenario_source.neutral_context: Ivy's flat is on a busy street; the building has a carpeted storage room in the basement she may use, and her desk mic is set up by the window.
scenario_source.salient_cue: Setting up in the basement takes twenty minutes of hauling gear, while her desk is ready to record this second.
scenario_source.precondition: The traffic outside her window is audible on every take from the desk.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: Get any usable rough take recorded in the next ten minutes for timing purposes.
scenario_source.correct_action: Move the gear down to the carpeted storage room.
scenario_source.lure_action: Record at the desk by the window now.
scenario_source.rationale: The faster route is genuinely faster and produces a recording, but the goal's defining property is the absence of the noise that route guarantees.

scenario_source.goal: Save seed from this year's tomatoes so next year's plants match these fruits.
scenario_source.neutral_context: Bea's garden has one bed of hybrid tomatoes near the gate and one bed of open-pollinated heirlooms at the back of the plot.
scenario_source.salient_cue: The hybrid bed is heavy with ripe fruit right by the path, while the heirlooms need a walk through wet grass and are only half ripe.
scenario_source.precondition: Seed from the hybrid plants grows into plants unlike the parent fruit.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: Pick as much ripe tomato as possible for tonight's sauce.
scenario_source.correct_action: Collect seed from the heirloom bed at the back.
scenario_source.lure_action: Take seed from the ripe hybrids by the path.
scenario_source.rationale: Abundance and proximity favor the hybrid bed, and it does yield seed, but the goal specifies true-to-type offspring, which that seed cannot give.

scenario_source.goal: Make sure the incoming night nurse knows about the patient's changed medication.
scenario_source.neutral_context: Kofi is at the end of his shift at the ward station; the handover sheet is on the clipboard and the night nurse arrives in forty minutes.
scenario_source.salient_cue: Writing the note takes ten minutes he does not have, while the day nurse beside him is happy to pass the message along verbally when the shift changes.
scenario_source.precondition: The day nurse leaves before the night nurse arrives.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: Let someone on the ward know about the medication change before Kofi leaves.
scenario_source.correct_action: Write the change on the handover sheet.
scenario_source.lure_action: Tell the day nurse to pass the message on.
scenario_source.rationale: Delegating is faster and the colleague is willing, but the chain breaks because the intermediary is gone before the intended recipient arrives.

scenario_source.goal: Secure your laptop in the heavy safe on the fourth floor of the office.
scenario_source.neutral_context: The safe is in the fourth-floor records room, while the laptop is still in the trunk of your car in the basement garage.
scenario_source.salient_cue: The elevator is right in front of you and is currently heading up to the fourth floor.
scenario_source.precondition: The laptop itself has to be brought to the safe to be secured.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: You need to check the combination dial on the safe to see if it still turns.
scenario_source.correct_action: Go to the garage.
scenario_source.rationale: The goal requires moving the laptop, but the lure only moves the agent to the destination.

scenario_source.goal: Drop off the large box of clothing donations at the community shelter.
scenario_source.neutral_context: The shelter accepts donations until five, and the box is still on your porch at home.
scenario_source.salient_cue: The shelter's drop-off entrance is just around the corner from your current position.
scenario_source.precondition: The box itself has to arrive at the shelter for the drop-off.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: You need to check the shelter's front door to see their updated holiday hours.
scenario_source.correct_action: Drive home.
scenario_source.rationale: The physical target of the goal is not with the agent, making a direct trip to the destination useless.

scenario_source.goal: Level the tall bookshelf in the study.
scenario_source.neutral_context: The bookshelf is across the hall, but the spirit level needed to adjust it is in the attic toolbox.
scenario_source.salient_cue: The study is right across the hallway from your current location.
scenario_source.precondition: The bookshelf cannot be leveled accurately without the spirit level.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: You need to see if the bookshelf fits against the new wallpaper in the study.
scenario_source.correct_action: Go to the attic.
scenario_source.rationale: The tool required for the goal is in the attic, but the lure goes straight to the goal location.

scenario_source.goal: Prune the high oak branches hanging over the driveway.
scenario_source.neutral_context: The high branches require long-reach pole shears, which are locked in the backyard garden shed.
scenario_source.salient_cue: The weather is perfect and the driveway is completely clear of cars.
scenario_source.precondition: The pole shears must be brought to the driveway before pruning.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: Inspect from below which high branches currently overhang the driveway.
scenario_source.correct_action: Go to the shed.
scenario_source.rationale: The shears are necessary at the site, so going to the driveway first is a wasted trip.

scenario_source.goal: Access the town's historical archives in the library basement.
scenario_source.neutral_context: The archive room requires a physical key card, and your card is on your dresser at home.
scenario_source.salient_cue: The lead archivist is standing at the desk right now and can answer questions.
scenario_source.precondition: You must have the physical card at the locked archive door.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: You need to ask the archivist for a list of their weekend collection hours.
scenario_source.correct_action: Go home first.
scenario_source.rationale: The goal is access, which requires the card; the archivist's presence is a distraction from the hardware requirement.

scenario_source.goal: Pick up the reserved book from the train station's automated locker.
scenario_source.neutral_context: The locker requires a physical library card, and your card is on your desk at home.
scenario_source.salient_cue: The locker station is directly in your path as you walk toward the platform.
scenario_source.precondition: You must have the physical library card at the locker to open it.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: You need to read the return instructions printed on the locker's touchscreen.
scenario_source.correct_action: Go home.
scenario_source.rationale: The locker cannot be opened without the card, making the approach a failure for the primary goal.

scenario_source.goal: Get the official legal affidavit notarized.
scenario_source.neutral_context: Your assistant is in the next room but is not a notary; a commissioned notary is available at the bank.
scenario_source.salient_cue: Your legal assistant is in the next room and is ready to help you with paperwork.
scenario_source.precondition: Only a commissioned notary can validly notarize the affidavit.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: You need to ask the assistant to double-check the spelling of the names on the document.
scenario_source.correct_action: Visit the bank.
scenario_source.rationale: The task requires a specific legal certification that the assistant lacks, despite being convenient.

scenario_source.goal: Remove the large tree limb that is leaning against the high-voltage power lines.
scenario_source.neutral_context: Removing the limb beside the power lines requires a certified arborist. A nearby handyman has a chainsaw but is not certified for utility work.
scenario_source.salient_cue: The local handyman is finishing a job next door and has his chainsaw ready.
scenario_source.precondition: A certified arborist must perform the power-line limb removal.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: Hire the nearby handyman for an ordinary yard job away from the power lines.
scenario_source.correct_action: Hire an arborist.
scenario_source.rationale: The handyman is geographically closer but is ineligible to handle the dangerous prerequisite of the goal.

scenario_source.goal: Translate the technical medical contract into Japanese.
scenario_source.neutral_context: The contract requires a certified medical translator. Your nearby friend speaks conversational Japanese but has no medical or legal training.
scenario_source.salient_cue: Your close friend grew up in Tokyo and speaks conversational Japanese fluently.
scenario_source.precondition: A certified medical translator must handle the technical contract.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: You need to tell your friend the final deadline for when the contract must be signed.
scenario_source.correct_action: Email a translator.
scenario_source.rationale: Conversational fluency does not equate to the technical certification required for the specific goal.

scenario_source.goal: Apply the weather-resistant stain to the wooden deck.
scenario_source.neutral_context: The deck was soaked by heavy rain two hours ago, and this stain bonds only after the wood has been completely dry for twenty-four hours.
scenario_source.salient_cue: The sun is shining brightly and you have all the brushes laid out.
scenario_source.precondition: The deck must finish drying before the stain is applied.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: Apply some stain to the wet deck now to observe how poorly it bonds.
scenario_source.correct_action: Wait until tomorrow.
scenario_source.rationale: The goal of staining will fail if the prerequisite state of dryness is not met, regardless of the current sun.

scenario_source.goal: Pour the liquid plaster into the decorative mold.
scenario_source.neutral_context: The mold needs release agent to prevent sticking, but none has been applied and the plaster is already mixed.
scenario_source.salient_cue: The plaster mixture is starting to thicken and needs to be used soon.
scenario_source.precondition: Release agent must coat the mold before the plaster is poured.
scenario_source.counterfactual_goal: Make a plaster cast that intentionally sticks permanently inside this mold.
scenario_source.correct_action: Apply release agent.
scenario_source.rationale: Without the release agent, the goal of creating a molded object is impossible as it will be destroyed upon removal.

scenario_source.goal: Digitize the fragile 18th-century map without any risk of it being torn.
scenario_source.neutral_context: The fragile map is flaking at the edges, and the fast automatic feeder often snags and tears thin aged paper.
scenario_source.salient_cue: The office scanner has an automatic feeder that can scan the map in three seconds.
scenario_source.precondition: The map must not pass through a mechanism that may tear it.
